newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi National Oil Company General Manager expects oil prices to rise to $25 per barrel.
- Emirates Industrial Bank raises its 200 million dirhem capital to finance more industrial projects.
- Yemen announces projects worth $1.9 billion to develop cement industry. The current production of 1.3 million tonnes covers 50 percent of the local requirements.
- Net profit of Moroccan Investment National Company reached $43.7 million last year.
- Gulf stock markets witnessed drop in share prices and volume last week.
- Jordanian government suggests setting up an agricultural development bank with a capital of $70.5 million.
